phases.name: hunt
phases.description: A2 leaf-2.0.1 hunter-pack leg: one QA lens review of the merged commit's diff, findings-only — the leg never edits or merges (ADR-1 §2). The box reviews the checkout at the merged SHA (the dispatch fill clone IS the merged tree), hunts defects under its assigned lens discipline, and finishes with a structured findings JSON. The 900000 phase cap (the loader schema's ceiling, manifest.ts) bounds a read-only review loop against the merged diff; runBudgetMs 2755000 prices the declared ceilings by the loader's rule (Σ (retries+1) × (PARSE_FIX_ATTEMPTS+1) × maxDurationMs + n × ROUTING_MARGIN_MS = 3×900000 + 3×15000 + 2×5000 = 2755000, ~2.4% headroom — the same pricing the fix-run manifest documents).
phases.task: You are one QA hunter-pack leg reviewing the checkout at its current HEAD (the merged commit under review). Work findings-only: do NOT edit any file, do NOT commit, do NOT touch git remotes — leave the tree exactly as the dispatch filled it (a later phase asserts the tree is clean). Hunt for defects in this commit's OWN surface: build the bounded review set with ONE command: `git diff --name-only HEAD~1..HEAD -- src/qa scripts/qa tests/qa` (typically a handful of files — the story's own surface; if it is empty, say so and finish with an empty findings array). Review ONLY the files in that list — do NOT grep or read beyond them (the team's budget is deliberately small). Review those files for: correctness bugs (logic errors, broken invariants, error-handling gaps, race/edge conditions), secret hygiene (any key, token, credential, or secret-shaped literal introduced or left exposed, including in tests and fixtures), and diff scope (changes outside the commit's stated purpose, unexplained included files, scope creep). Be thorough but bounded: report only findings you are confident are real. When you finish, the team finish with EXACTLY one JSON object of shape {"findings": [{"finding_text": "<one-sentence finding>", "diff_context_ref": "<path[:line] or symbol the finding concerns>"}], "changedFiles": []} as the final output — the write-capable teammate MUST include the mandatory changedFiles field (an empty array: findings-only work changes nothing) — an empty findings array is a valid result when the diff is clean. No other trailing text after the JSON.

phases.name: verify-clean-tree
phases.description: Proves the findings-only invariant on the box as far as the box can see it: the hunt phase must leave the worktree clean — a committed edit would hide behind an empty `git status --porcelain`, so the HOST driver additionally asserts the phase's echoed HEAD (`head=<sha>` line) equals the merged commitSha. Companion phase required by the shipped manifest loader (MIN_PHASES = 2, src/phase-engine/types.ts:57) — the review work itself is entirely phase 1's.
command: test -z "$(git status --porcelain)" || { echo 'findings-only violated: the hunt phase edited the checkout' >&2; exit 1; }; echo "head=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
